snippet.title: DCKO - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Don't miss the Announcement Trailer for DCKO, a free-to-play mobile fighting game developed by Drop Fake. Players will step into the ring with iconic DC heroes and villains to duke it out across the DC Universe. Take the fight online to face off against real players, play solo in PvE missions, and unlock new upgrades, costumes, and more. DCKO is coming soon to iOS and Android.

#IGN #Gaming #DC
